_comment: Conversations section settings (owner decision 2026-10-15). staleAfterMinutes: an unread, inbound-last conversation counts as stale once its last message is older than this. businessHours: the window used for response times, in America/New_York; days use 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday; endHour is exclusive (7 and 20 = 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM). optOutKeywords and interestKeywords are matched as whole words in inbound message text; a keyword written in capitals (IT) must match in capitals, every other keyword ignores case. replyWindowDays: how long after an inbound message a human reply still counts as a reply to it. withinMinutes: the 'replied within' target shown on the response-time card.

responseLevels._note: Median response chart colors (business minutes): green under greenUnderMinutes, yellow under yellowUnderMinutes, red at or above.

emailStatus._note: Email engagement statuses are read one email at a time from GHL (GET /conversations/messages/email/{id}). Emails sent within lookbackDays are re-read every refreshHours; older ones are read once and frozen as final. maxPerRun caps the reads done in one 15-minute sync so a pass resumes across runs.

optOutRateLevels._note: Opt-outs ÷ sends per template: at or above high = High (red), at or above medium = Medium (orange), below = Low (green).

interestRateLevels._note: Interest replies ÷ sends per template: at or above high = High (green), at or above medium = Medium (orange), below = Low (red).
